title: KeyError crash when fetching weather for some cities
body:
Getting a KeyError when I try to fetch weather for certain cities. Seems like the API changed its response format.

```
KeyError: 'main'
```

Happens with cities that return an error response instead of weather data. The 'main' key doesn't exist in those responses.

**Steps to reproduce:**
1. Call `parse_weather` with a response that doesn't have a 'main' key
2. Observe: unhandled KeyError

**Version:** 1.0.0
**Python:** 3.12

comments.author: meera-writes-code
comments.body: Same issue here. The API docs mention the format changed in their latest version.

comments.author: infra-nerd-9
comments.body: Is anyone working on this? PR #19 looks like it already has a fix.

lesson_feedback: PR #19 has been open for 9 months with a correct fix. The maintainer never responded. Even if you wrote a fix, it won't get reviewed — the repo is abandoned.

reproductionSteps.instruction: Open weather.py and find the parse_weather function.
Call parse_weather with a response missing the 'main' key: parse_weather({'cod': 404, 'message': 'city not found'})

fixedBehavior.output: Returns {'error': 'Unexpected API response format.'} — clean error, no crash.

title: Is this project still maintained?
body: Last commit was over a year ago and PRs are going unanswered. Is this project still being maintained? I'd like to contribute but it seems like nothing is getting reviewed.

comments.author: anon-contributor
comments.body: Same question. I opened a PR months ago with no response.

comments.author: meera-writes-code
comments.body: I think it's abandoned. The maintainer's GitHub profile hasn't had any activity either.

lesson_feedback: This isn't a bug report — it's a signal. The maintainer hasn't replied to anything in 13 months. This repo isn't the right place for a first contribution.

reproductionSteps.instruction: Check the date of the last commit in the Commits tab.
Count how many open PRs have no maintainer response.
Check whether the maintainer has replied to any issue in the last year.

reproduction.expectedResult: A repo where the maintainer is responsive and PRs get reviewed.

buggyBehavior.output: Last commit 15+ months ago. 4 open PRs, all unanswered. Maintainer silent 13 months.

fixedBehavior.output: N/A — this is a repo health signal, not a bug.

title: Add Fahrenheit option
body: It would be nice to have a flag to display temperature in Fahrenheit instead of Celsius. Should be a simple addition to format_output.
lesson_feedback: Technically a small change, but it's labeled good first issue on an abandoned repo. Nobody will review your PR. The label means nothing if the maintainer isn't there.

reproductionSteps.instruction: Check when the maintainer last replied to any issue or PR.
Count how many open PRs are waiting for review.

reproduction.expectedResult: A feature request with an active maintainer who will review contributions.

buggyBehavior.output: Open feature request on an abandoned repo. No maintainer activity in 13 months.

fixedBehavior.output: N/A — the issue itself is fine, but the repo context makes it a bad pick.

title: API key invalid?
body: Getting an error about invalid API key. Not sure what's happening. Can someone help?
lesson_feedback: No steps, no error message, no version, no API key source mentioned. Not enough information to help — and the maintainer won't reply anyway.

reproductionSteps.instruction: Check if there are steps to reproduce.
Check if an error message is included.
Check if a Python version or API key source is mentioned.

reproduction.expectedResult: A bug report with steps, error output, version, and enough context to reproduce.

buggyBehavior.output: No steps, no error message, no version. Cannot be investigated.

fixedBehavior.output: N/A — needs more information from the reporter.
